xlmr_comet_backbone_coverage_check.generated_by: manual check against xlmr_cc100_languages.tsv (XLM-R paper Table 6, Conneau et al. 2020, arXiv:1911.02116)
xlmr_comet_backbone_coverage_check.note: COMET-22/23 and CometKiwi-22/23 are all built on the XLM-R-large encoder; if a language isn't in XLM-R's own CC-100 pretraining data, COMET-family metrics have no learned representation for it.
xlmr_comet_backbone_coverage_check.conclusion: None of arn/nah/ikt/ike/iu/quy/qu appear in XLM-R's 100-language CC-100 pretraining list. Confirms (not just assumes) COMET-family metrics are unreliable for Mapudungun, Nahuatl, Inuktitut, and Quechua -- consistent with the Mapudungun paper's own disclosed COMET-22 limitation, now extended with direct evidence to COMET-23/CometKiwi-23 as well, since they share the same XLM-R backbone.
